free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable: Personio has no ongoing free tier. Its terms describe a 14-day trial, while API access is listed under the paid Core Pro plan.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits include a global v1 limit of 2,000 requests per minute per IP; endpoint-specific limits also apply.

cors.correction: Personio uses CORS to prevent browsers from retrieving data directly from its APIs.

notes: The v1 employee example remains documented and operational, although Personio now also offers v2 APIs. Authentication varies by API generation: v2 uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials, while legacy v1 personnel endpoints exchange Personio credentials for a bearer token and legacy recruiting uses a separate token.
